posts.text: Patrick Graham details how the Steelers can help improve on missed tackles: “First, you address it with the group and point out where we're missing tackles, whether it's the angles we're taking, our technique when we wrap up, or other fundamental issues. From there, it's our job as coaches to figure out how to drill it and improve it. Obviously, we're not going to do live tackling during the season, but we have to find ways to practice it so the players can get better and see real evidence of that improvement. That's been a big part of our self-scouting during this mini-bye. We've looked at where we can improve, where we can put guys in better positions, and even what schematic adjustments we can make to help. Whether it's tackling in space, defending screens, or making sure we finish on the quarterback, we have to attack those issues head-on and find ways to drill them. That's what we have to do as coaches.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.text: Brian Batko on the season TJ Watt is having in 2026: “Nick Herbig was asked about T.J. Watt a lot yesterday while we were doing the show, and he basically said, 'Yeah, he's just different. He does different things.' Someone asked if he'd ever seen that move we talked about yesterday, where T.J. is in the middle of a pass rush, then suddenly spins back around, seems to have eyes in the back of his head, and pokes the ball away. I think it was against Quinshon Judkins for a pass breakup. Herbig didn't say it exactly like this, but he kind of answered the question with another question: 'Have you ever seen a guy run full speed at a quarterback and pick off a pass?' At that point, there's no use trying to make sense of what T.J. does on a week-to-week basis. That's a pretty good way of putting it from the young Mr. Herbig.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.
